quality.review_scope: The preparation and direct HRTEM/XRD claims are source-reviewed against the accepted independent audit. The record also carries checked p.3 solution absorption/PL and separately scoped downstream array/device PL/EL contexts. Reader mapping preserves sample, figure and method lineage; parent-method quantities remain attributed to Rogach and unconfirmed as unchanged in 2005.

pH adjuster/amount; N2 saturation time/flow/vessel; H2Te dose/flow/duration/endpoint/generator recipe in O’Connor; propan-2-ol quantity; stirring speed; centrifuge RCF/rotor/washes; exact retained fraction.
Whether Rogach initial charges, gas-generator inputs or ~30 mL concentration step were carried into the O’Connor pH-10 adaptation.
Coded synthesis batch and exact aliquot lineage across solution optical, HRTEM and XRD assays.
Named geometric morphology, refined unit-cell parameters, atomic coordinates/CIF and measured molecular geometries.

conflicts: Rogach 1999 parent protocol reports pH 11.2 with 1 M NaOH, while O’Connor 2005 adaptation directly reports pH 10.0; preserve as source-specific difference, not one reconciled condition.
